case: PostgreSQL custom enum-array XLSX re-import through LibreOffice Calc
contract: PostgreSQL's enum[] result contains the literal NULL label, empty label, Unicode, comma, quote, markup and SQL NULL; native type, JSON and array_send checks pass through the existing BookieE file-writer test.
BookieE writes the array text into XLSX as one shared-string cell without a formula; the cell equals the driver's native enum-array text.
LibreOffice Calc opens the workbook and saves it as ODS, then reopens and saves XLSX; the cell remains a string with identical 43-code-point text across all three files.

bookiee_export.command: rtk proxy env BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=/home/trung/Projects/tablepro/linux/docs/evidence/postgres-enum-array-calc-reimport-results-2026-10-04/source.xlsx cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract::value_contract_custom_enum_array_file_exports_preserve_labels -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

steps: In the pinned Debian image, apt installs libreoffice-calc; Calc 26.8.0.3 opens source.xlsx and saves recheck/source.ods.
Calc reopens recheck/source.ods and saves recheck/source.xlsx, which is retained as calc-roundtrip.xlsx.

consumer_assertions.result: All three artifacts contain the same string cell and value.

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families/configurations and spreadsheet-application re-import for other cell shapes remain open in B3.
